SELECT p.productId, p.codeBId, p.name, p.price, p.isActive FROM PRODUCT p WHERE p.isActive = 1
AND UPPER(p.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%')
ORDER BY p.name DESC OFFSET #{startRow} LIMIT (#{endRow} - #{startRow} + 1)

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PRODUCT p WHERE p.isActive = 1
AND UPPER(p.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%')

SELECT e.EMPNUM AS empNum, e.EMPNAME AS empName, e.EMPEMAIL AS empEmail FROM EMPLOYEE e WHERE e.FIREDATE IS NULL
AND ( UPPER(e.EMPNAME) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%') OR UPPER(e.EMPEMAIL) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%') )
ORDER BY e.EMPNAME ASC OFFSET #{startRow} LIMIT #{endRow} - #{startRow} + 1
